verdict.rationale: llamafile bundles an HTTP server with API and Web UI (llamafile-docs-9, llamafile-docs-5) and its security model explicitly allows accept() of incoming connections rather than only loopback (llamafile-docs-10), implying LAN-servable capability, but no evidence documents a --host/--port flag for binding to 0.0.0.0 or any community report of successfully accessing it from another device on the network. Missing for 10: explicit docs on binding to a network interface for remote/LAN access, and hands-on confirmation from another device.
